title: AuditEvent
description: Compliance-grade record of every consequential action in SENTINEL — human or automated. Distinct from agent_result/action_result: this is the human-readable 'who did what and why' record used for regulatory reporting and post-incident investigation.

actor.description: Identity of who/what performed the action — user_id, agent_id, or 'system'

action.description: e.g. permit_block, action_approved, action_rejected, zone_locked, threshold_changed, model_deployed

target_type.description: e.g. permit, zone, action, agent_config, rule

reason.description: Why this action was taken — e.g. 'risk_score_95', 'manual_override_per_SOP_4.2'

before_state.description: State snapshot before the action, where applicable

after_state.description: State snapshot after the action, where applicable

regulatory_relevant.description: Flags entries required for regulatory retention/reporting
